summary: About one in five public school students attend a school where most students qualify for free or reduced-price lunch.
realLife: In fall 2021, about 10.5 million students, 21 percent of public school students, attended high-poverty schools, where more than 75 percent of students were eligible.
sources: NCES, Fast Facts: Public school students eligible for free or reduced-price lunch: https://nces.ed.gov/fastfacts/display.asp?id=898
inGame: the school row's share of eligible students. needs: eligibility share on the school row.

turns.what: A low-poverty school, where few students are eligible.
